## Download CodeLab Studio Public Preview

Choose an installer from **Assets**.

| Platform | File | Installation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `macos-universal.dmg` | Open the disk image and drag CodeLab Studio into Applications. This preview uses ad hoc signing and has no Apple notarization. macOS may ask you to approve the first launch in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**. |
| Windows (x64) | `windows-x64.exe` | Run the installer. This preview is unsigned and Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may display a warning. |
| Linux (x64) | `linux-x64.AppImage` | Make the AppImage executable and run it. The build uses Ubuntu 22.04 and requires AppImage/FUSE support. |

Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the downloaded installer.
